# Loved by Engineering teams

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5e4d9854e6dad067f4b514b3/69c554c961b91a1097589ce7_64364643.svg)

We’re now starting to work with conversion partners through CoLabyears beforewe’re ready to go into production, which historically is when they’d see that first bit of product.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5e4d9854e6dad067f4b514b3/6627cf0e88230dd00f6d9882_Simon%20Robinson.webp)

Simon Robinson

Chief Engineer

![Ford logo](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5e4d9854e6dad067f4b514b3/68f24ca4c9dfb43b12494547_g2317.svg)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5e4d9854e6dad067f4b514b3/69c554c961b91a1097589ce7_64364643.svg)

It 100% improved the drawing quality and issue capture rate — no disputing that. Everything’s centralized, everyone’s in one place, and I can go in, fact-check, and ensure the right decisions are being made. It’s already way better than we’ve ever done before — and it’s only going to keep improving.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5e4d9854e6dad067f4b514b3/68ff58ecbf9836d347931bba_Amy%20Brown2.avif)

Project Manager, LHD & Trucks

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5e4d9854e6dad067f4b514b3/69c554c961b91a1097589ce7_64364643.svg)

With our normal in person events we’d find more than 100 opportunities for value-add on the models we’re reviewing. This year with our virtual events in CoLab, we’re averaging over 200.
